556:t_6:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I want to stay like this forever...)

556:t_6:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Everyone will see us... It's embarrassing, so embarrassing... But... I don't care anymore...)

556:t_6:58.en:
$$かなめ$$
(My love keeps growing... It won't stop. I can't stop it...)

556:t_6:59.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I've... always wanted to do this. I'm sure he has, too...)

556:t_6:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「As long as I have you, I don't need weapons.」

556:t_6:65.en:
$$かなめ$$
(This is the world I chose... The world where I'll... live with $$宗介$$...)

556:t_6:69.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$ Bridge～

556:t_6:70.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...We've confirmed that Sergeant $$相良宗介$$ is alive. I'll dispatch a team to recover $$レーバテイン$$.」

556:t_6:72.en:
$$ボビー$$
「What a relief, Captain $$テッサ$$.」

556:t_6:75.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I thought I'd sob my heart out, yet I find myself calm...)

556:t_6:76.en:
$$テッサ$$
(But I'm sure the suffering will come someday. I was the one who brought about his death...)

556:t_6:77.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Whatever he was like... he was the last family I had left...)

556:t_6:78.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「...And here is the list of those killed in this battle.」

556:t_6:79.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We must not let their precious sacrifice be in vain.」

556:t_6:81.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain! Incoming transmission from Director $$大塚$$ at the Far East Branch!」

556:t_6:82.en:
$$ラム$$
「A distortion has formed in the dimensional boundary at the edge of the Earth Sphere, apparently due to that $$時空震動$$!」

556:t_6:83.en:
$$ラム$$
「They report that an army believed to be the $$バアル$$ has emerged from it!」

556:t_6:84.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Inform all ships! Once we've completed essential resupply, $c is heading into space!」

556:t_6:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... We will protect this world that you and $$カリーニン$$ called distorted.)

556:t_6:88.en:
$$テッサ$$
(That is our responsibility as the ones who stopped your ambition, and $c's mission.)

556:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about that, $n! The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and I helped bring $$宗介$$ back alive!」

556:t_10:9.en:
$n
「It was $$レナード$$'s attack on the $$クォーター$$... That's when...」

556:t_10:11.en:
$n
「...Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$... You're part of the reason $$宗介$$ survived.」

556:t_10:12.en:
$n
「If he and $$千鳥$$ stop by, give them my regards.」

556:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I had planned a sale today to celebrate $$かなめ$$'s return, but this hardly seems the time.」

556:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll leave the ace pilot celebrations for another occasion, too.」

556:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... today we'll mourn $$ティティ$$ and quietly... do business, do business...」

557:t_000:0.en:
$$ダヴ$$
「Quite a sight, Boss. This really is one massive showdown.」

557:t_000:2.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「What's wrong, Boss? You not feeling it?」

557:t_000:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「That bastard $$ゲイツ$$ is dead, and that bastard $$カン・ユー$$ is missing...」

557:t_000:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「We've been scraping by without the boss, but maybe it's time to call it quits...」

557:t_000:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「First, $$アマルガム$$. I just can't get into this operation.」

557:t_000:7.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「That's bad news. If we desert on the eve of the showdown with $c...」

557:t_000:8.en:
$$ベック$$
「You guys... know what that silver-haired pretty boy's planning?」

557:t_000:10.en:
$$ベック$$
「Nope. I only just found out myself... when I eavesdropped on the big shots...」

557:t_000:11.en:
$$ベック$$
「Those bastards... are apparently planning $$時空修復$$.」

557:t_000:13.en:
$$ベック$$
「Well... whatever... All it'll do is create a new parallel world, and the me there will live without knowing a thing.」

557:t_000:14.en:
$$ベック$$
「But that me won't even know his world was created by someone to suit their own wishes...」

557:t_000:15.en:
$$ベック$$
「It pisses me off. Basically, that me will have had his past... his memories stolen.」

557:t_000:17.en:
$$ベック$$
「Well... I'm just griping. Our guests should be here soon.」

557:t_001:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never expected you to greet us, $$ベック$$.」

557:t_001:2.en:
$$ベック$$
「It's not like I want to, but I guess we're stuck with each other.」

557:t_001:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「I'll make it one hell of a show!」

557:t_001:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! The dimensional boundary in this area is already showing abnormal distortion!」

557:t_001:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So their plan is already underway?」

557:t_001:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We must stop $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ and $$千鳥かなめ$$ as soon as possible!」

557:t_001:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「First, we'll crush the enemy interception force.」

557:t_001:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「ASes, mobile suits, $$ファイヤバグ$$...! They sure gathered a lot of troops!」

557:t_001:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's probably thanks to $$アマルガム$$'s connections with so many organizations.」

557:t_001:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「They've even outwitted the Empire to pull this off. They've got some nerve.」

557:t_001:14.en:
$$アスカ$$
「They told us the dimensional boundary was distorted! You chose to sortie, so get it together!」
